summary: Qfin Holdings filed a Form 6-K with the SEC announcing its annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 30, 2026. The meeting agenda includes the re-appointment of Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu as auditors and authorization for the board to set their remuneration. The record date for Class A ordinary shares is May 27, 2026 (Hong Kong time), and ADS holders must provide voting instructions by that date. This is a routine governance filing, not a special situation.
